description: S3 buckets must implement a lifecycle policy

requirements.description: S3 bucket has no LifecycleConfiguration property at all
requirements.rationale: The rule requires a lifecycle policy. An S3 bucket without LifecycleConfiguration has no lifecycle rules and is non-compliant.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration with at least one rule whose Status is Enabled and contains a valid action (e.g., ExpirationInDays)
requirements.rationale: A bucket with an active lifecycle rule satisfies the requirement to implement a lifecycle policy.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration with Rules set to an empty array
requirements.rationale: An empty Rules array means no lifecycle policy is actually applied; the configuration provides no lifecycle behavior.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration with rules but every rule has Status set to Disabled
requirements.rationale: Per S3 lifecycle rule semantics, a rule with Status=Disabled is not applied. If all rules are disabled, no lifecycle policy is in effect.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration with multiple rules where some are Disabled but at least one has Status=Enabled with a valid action
requirements.rationale: At least one enabled rule satisfies the requirement that the bucket implements a lifecycle policy.

requirements.description: S3 bucket's LifecycleConfiguration property is set via an unresolvable intrinsic function (e.g., Fn::If with one branch as AWS::NoValue, Fn::ImportValue)
requirements.rationale: When the lifecycle configuration cannot be deterministically resolved at scan time, the rule cannot assert non-compliance.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration with a rule whose Status value is an unresolvable intrinsic function
requirements.rationale: The rule cannot determine whether the rule is enabled or disabled when the Status is unresolvable, so it should not flag.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_s3_bucket resource without any associated aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration resource and without inline lifecycle_rule block
requirements.rationale: No lifecycle policy is implemented for the bucket, violating the rule.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration resource exists in the template but its bucket attribute targets a different bucket (not the assessed bucket)
requirements.rationale: A lifecycle configuration that points to another bucket does not provide coverage for the assessed bucket.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration with bucket attribute referencing the assessed bucket and at least one rule with status = "Enabled" and a valid action
requirements.rationale: A separate lifecycle configuration resource that explicitly targets the assessed bucket and is enabled satisfies the rule.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration targeting the assessed bucket but with all rules status = "Disabled"
requirements.rationale: All rules are disabled, so no lifecycle policy is actively applied to the bucket.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration targeting the assessed bucket with no rule blocks
requirements.rationale: Without any rules, the lifecycle configuration provides no actual lifecycle policy.

requirements.description: S3 bucket lifecycle rule uses a broad Filter (empty prefix '' or no filter, matching all objects) with Status=Enabled and a valid action
requirements.rationale: A lifecycle rule that applies to all objects in the bucket fully satisfies the requirement to implement a lifecycle policy.

requirements.description: Terraform aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration with bucket attribute set via an unresolvable expression (e.g., variable or remote state) so target bucket cannot be determined
requirements.rationale: If the bucket reference cannot be resolved, the rule cannot definitively assert that the assessed bucket lacks coverage.

requirements.description: S3 bucket lifecycle rule has Status=Enabled and a valid action but is scoped via a Filter (e.g., Prefix='logs/' or specific tag) so it only applies to a subset of objects
requirements.rationale: Per resolved ambiguity: any enabled rule with any filter satisfies 'must implement a lifecycle policy'; the rule does not require coverage of all objects.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration with a rule whose Status=Enabled but no action property (no ExpirationInDays, ExpirationDate, Transitions, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, NoncurrentVersionTransitions, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload, etc.)
requirements.rationale: Per resolved ambiguity: a rule must have at least one action property to count as implementing a lifecycle policy. A rule without any action provides no lifecycle behavior.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration with an enabled rule whose only action is AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload (no expiration or transition actions)
requirements.rationale: Per resolved ambiguity: AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload counts as a valid lifecycle policy action and satisfies the rule.

requirements.description: S3 bucket has LifecycleConfiguration set to AWS::NoValue via an Fn::If condition (the resource explicitly omits the lifecycle configuration when condition is false at scan-time evaluation)
requirements.rationale: When LifecycleConfiguration resolves to AWS::NoValue (deterministically absent), the bucket has no lifecycle policy and should be flagged like the ABSENT case.
